samples.summary: `TextEditor.siblingsOf` returns the body-only `doc.document.blocks`, ignoring the header/footer edit context, so Tab / Shift+Tab / Cmd+] on a list item while editing a header or footer now plans no change at all (silent no-op where it previously worked).
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2865 `if (!info) return this.doc.document.blocks;` — but the doc's own accessor is context-scoped: packages/docs/src/model/document.ts:158-160 `getContextBlocks()` returns `header.blocks` / `footer.blocks` when `editContext !== 'body'`, and `getBlockIndex` (document.ts:271) is built on it. Header/footer editing is a live mode in this very class (text-editor.ts:403-406 `setEditContext`, 4580-4581 active layout, and `getCellInfo` at 3639-3643 deliberately uses the *active* layout). Because `planSiblingGroup` only emits changes for ids it finds inside the passed array (packages/docs/src/model/list-level.ts:64-84), a header list item handed the body array matches nothing and `handleTab`/`handleIndent`/`handleOutdent` become no-ops. The sibling implementation in editor.ts:1616 gets this right (`doc.getContextBlocks()`), which is the inconsistency. Same root affects the multi-block branch at text-editor.ts:2836 (`this.doc.document.blocks` indexed with context-scoped indices). Fix belongs on the new code: use `this.doc.getContextBlocks()`.

samples.summary: Toolbar `indent()`/`outdent()` now mutate `listLevel` on subtree children that lie OUTSIDE the selection, but only walked blocks are passed to `markDirty`, so the incremental layout cache reuses those children's stale lines — text stays at the old indent while ordered-list numbering (recomputed from live blocks) updates, until some later edit dirties them.
samples.evidence: Incremental cache hit reuses lines laid out with the OLD list indent: packages/docs/src/view/layout.ts:535-536 `} else if (canUseCache && !dirtyBlockIds!.has(block.id) && cache!.blocks.has(block.id)) { lines = cache!.blocks.get(block.id)!.lines; }` — the `effectiveBlock` with `marginLeft + LIST_INDENT_PX * (listLevel+1)` (layout.ts:493-501) is only consumed in the miss branch. `markDirty` is called only for blocks the walker visits (editor.ts:1698, 1707), and the un-selected subtree children are visited by neither walk. Unlike `toggleList` (editor.ts:3561) which calls `invalidateLayout()`, `indent()`/`outdent()` (editor.ts:3578, 3596) go straight to `render()` → `recomputeLayout()` with the partial dirty set (editor.ts:2246-2248, 1527). Meanwhile `computeListCounters` (layout.ts:1080-1099) reads live `block.listLevel`, so markers renumber while the text does not move. Fix on the new code: mark every planned block dirty in `applyListLevelChanges`, or call `invalidateLayout()` in indent/outdent.

samples.summary: The clipboard parser keeps its own private `MAX_LIST_LEVEL = 8` even though the new module exports the canonical constant and its doc comment claims to match that clamp — the two will drift.
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/clipboard.ts:57 `const MAX_LIST_LEVEL = 8;` used at clipboard.ts:351 `Math.min(MAX_LIST_LEVEL, ...)`, while packages/docs/src/model/list-level.ts:7 exports `MAX_LIST_LEVEL = 8` and its comment (list-level.ts:3-5) asserts it matches "the clamp the clipboard parser applies". Raising one leaves the other behind; clipboard.ts should import the export.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. text-editor.ts:2865 does return `this.doc.document.blocks` when the block is not in a table cell, and 2836 indexes `this.doc.document.blocks` with indices produced by the context-scoped `doc.getBlockIndex` (document.ts:271-273 -> getContextBlocks at 158-162, which returns header/footer blocks when editContext !== 'body'). Because planSiblingGroup (list-level.ts:64-84) only emits changes for ids it finds inside the passed array, a header/footer list item handed the body array yields zero changes, so handleTab (2680-2705), handleIndent (2750-2762) and handleOutdent (2764-2778) silently do nothing for list items in header/footer. The path is reachable: setEditContext sets doc.editContext (402-407), getCellInfo uses the active header/footer layout (3639-3644), the Tab key case at 1120-1123 has no editContext gate (unlike the explicit body-only gate at 1114), and TextEditor is the production keyboard path (view/editor.ts:2493). No guard elsewhere prevents it — editor.ts:1612-1616 is a separate toolbar-path implementation that correctly uses doc.getContextBlocks(), which is exactly the inconsistency; every other block-array read in text-editor.ts uses getContextBlocks(). Cross-module invariant (sibling-array containment in list-level.ts; index-space contract of getBlockIndex) violated at a consumer the diff does not show, and a prior regression of the same shape is documented in test/view/backward-selection-toggle.test.ts:861-874. Major: reachable silent no-op / wrong-array indexing.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. planListLevelChanges expands each selected list item to its whole adjacency-derived subtree (model/list-level.ts:69-81), so applyListLevelChanges (view/editor.ts:1595-1606) writes listLevel on children the selection walker never visited. markDirty is only called for walked blocks (view/editor.ts:1654, 1674, 1698, 1707), and indent()/outdent() (view/editor.ts:3568-3598) call render() without invalidateLayout() — unlike toggleList (3561) and setBlockType (3485) — so recomputeLayout (1511-1535) passes the partial dirty set to computeLayout. canUseCache is satisfied (layout.ts:456-459) and the hit branch reuses stored lines verbatim (layout.ts:535-536), bypassing the effectiveBlock indent (layout.ts:493-502) whose marginLeft is baked into run x (layout.ts:666-686). Meanwhile markers/counters are recomputed from live block.listLevel at paint time (layout.ts:1084-1099; paint-layout.ts:199; doc-canvas.ts:600), so markers renumber and shift while the child text stays at the old indent. Reachable even for a cursor-only indent on a parent with nested children. No guard elsewhere re-dirties those blocks (no doc-change subscription invalidates the cache).
